notablePrerequisites: There are at least five +1/+1 counters on Animar.You control up to seven untapped lands that can tap for {2}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
description:
Activate your lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Palinchron by paying {U}{U}.
Animar triggers, getting a +1/+1 counter.
Palinchron enters the battlefield, triggering itself, untapping up to seven lands.
Pay {2}{U}{U} to Palinchron, returning it to hand.
Repeat.
If your lands can tap for an additional mana, this combo produces infinite mana.
